_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Ethan Cole
about_me: I'm Ethan, an analyst at Huron Ventures in Ann Arbor, working with Theo Vance. We invest in seed-stage software and mobility. I'm looking for Michigan student founders before they raise.
goals: Meet 20 pre-seed Michigan founders this term

debriefs.text: Theo Vance, our associate, is running the summer 2027 analyst hiring and wants candidates from the Venture Club.
Met Kofi Asante, founder of TutorLoop, raising a pre-seed for his tutoring app. He wants school district pilots.
Keisha Morrow at Maize Launch sends us her top teams before demo day.
Olivia Grant, our talent partner, asked me to find embedded engineers for a portfolio company.
Talked to Chen Wei from GM, who might start a warehouse robotics company.
